scope: production QML windows/SQLite/bridge; synthetic CLI; offscreen/private XDG/D-Bus; no phone/compositor
checks: closed window and notification center never read; phone read sync updates shared unread and expires the exact toast
actual Qt window focus gates reads; visible IDs produce one grouped sendReceipt; empty privacy-off CLI result accepted without changing settings
minimized, unfocused and locked states receive into SQLite without producing reads
scrolling reads only the visible range; a new message outside it stays unread
native rows show sent/delivered/read/viewed monotonically with Material icon and accessible label
reaching the latest message clears older unread entries; SQLite and shared unread agree
hard reload preserves unread/read markers and does not repeat submitted read RPCs
